newsitem.title: GREECE: WORKER KILLED AT GREEK AMMUNITION PLANT EXPLOSION.
newsitem.headline: WORKER KILLED AT GREEK AMMUNITION PLANT EXPLOSION.

text.p: One worker was killed and at least five were injured, one of them seriously, from an explosion at the Powder and Cartridge Company (Pyrkal) at Lavrion on Friday, police said.
The police did not have details.
Lavrion mayor Stavros Papastavropoulos, who witnessed the accident, told Flash radio that the explosion occurred from excess potassium nitrate during the disposal of waste.

The mayor said a 52-year-old worker was killed instantly while another was seriously injured. Five or six others had lighter injuries, he added, terming the incident "the most tragic event that could have occurred in this town". --Artemis Hionides, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
